outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: Dichorionic twin pregnancies (121 spontaneous, 79 ART) delivered at the Maternity Teaching Hospital in Erbil, Iraq.
finding: Twin pregnancies conceived through assisted reproductive technology were associated with a significantly higher incidence of adverse maternal outcomes (pregnancy-induced hypertension, gestational diabetes, preterm rupture of membranes) and perinatal outcomes (preterm birth, low neonatal birth weight, congenital malformation, NICU admission) compared to spontaneously conceived twin pregnancies.
